name: manual_80225a
claim: When resuming a previously-spawned Claude Agent-tool subagent, use SendMessage(to=<agentId>), never Agent() again — Agent() always spawns a fresh, unrelated agent with zero prior context.

decisions.notes: During PR #205 quad-CEO-review (2026-07-12), used Agent() twice intending to redirect/resume an existing subagent; both times it silently spawned a new unrelated agent instead. Caught only because the user asked directly. One of the accidental spawns became a useful control case (proved context isolation works correctly when NOT leaked).
